claim: Under the Sakai non-generic intersection form for PIII(D_6) (KNY 2017 sec.3.3 eq (3.26), shown to coincide with the generic configuration-independent Pic form), the canonical KNY 2017 sec.8.2.19 eq (8.101) seven simple roots delta_0,...,delta_6 give an integer D_6^{(1)} affine root system embedding with self-intersection -2, orthogonal to -K_X, and Gram matrix equal to the symmetric D_6^{(1)} Cartan form with two-fork topology. The predecessor R1-ROUTE-F-POC alpha_0,...,alpha_6 also satisfy the Cartan condition under the same form (since the form is unchanged) but are not equal as an unordered set of integer vectors to the KNY delta_i. Verdict: SAKAI_FORM_REQUIRES_NEW_EMBEDDING.

Fixing the cycle-1 canonical Sakai-convention KNY embedding from R1-ROUTE-F-SAKAI-NONGEN (bridge commit 53efe94): the rank-7 sublattice L_delta = Z<delta_0,...,delta_6> spanned by the KNY 2017 sec.8.2.19 eq (8.101) simple roots is SATURATED inside the rank-9 orthogonal complement K_X^perp = {v in Pic(X) : <v, -K_X> = 0} under the configuration-independent Pic intersection form (KNY sec.3.3 eq 3.26). Concretely, the Smith Normal Form of the 7x9 integer matrix expressing the delta_i in a constructed Z-basis of K_X^perp has elementary divisors (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1) and saturation index 1. The KNY imaginary root delta_imag = sum_i (1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1)_i delta_i equals K_anti = -K_X, which is isotropic ((-K_X)^2 = 0) and itself lies in K_X^perp.
